Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 27

“Seeing all these kinsmen arrayed before him, Arjuna, the son of Kunti, overwhelmed with deep compassion, spoke these sorrowful words.”

The word used here — kripa, compassion — is significant. Arjuna's crisis isn't cowardice; it springs from an excess of love and pity for people he's about to be asked to kill.
